topic: AC1018 TABLE cell appearance DXF output mapping
scope: Generated ASCII/Binary DXF writer and parser self-consistency only; no physical producer or native rendering qualification

authority.dwg_specification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files, v5.4.1 §20.4.96.1

constraints: Group 283 is emitted when selected even when its stored boolean is false; the wire value is preserved verbatim without assigning fill semantics.
Groups 63/64 are emitted only for selected cell overrides and only for canonical indexed color values 0 through 256 with method 0.
A selected text-style hard pointer or name-only DXF cell override is emitted as group 7 only when it resolves to exactly one safe, emitted STYLE name; unresolved or ambiguous references fail closed.
Unselected color/state residue, unsupported color methods, unknown override bits, and unresolved STYLE pointers are refused before output publication.
